**Main line:** Qxd3 Bxc3 Qxc3+ Ke2

**Coaching note:**
White's bishop on d3 is undefended—Black's queen attacks it immediately. The key insight: don't just capture it; look one move ahead. After Qxd3, if White recaptures with Bxc3, you recapture with Qxc3+, winning the bishop *with check*. This forces White's king to move, so he can't fight back. The lesson: when you see an undefended piece, always ask if capturing it creates a follow-up threat that prevents counterplay.
